about.title: Get to Know Us
about.intro: Meet our bistro, our team, and our story.
about.body:
A long time ago, an idea took shape: a place of our own for coming together, sharing, and growing. We have grown, weathered an intense beginning, and now we want to share this place with you.
We, David, Till, and our wonderful team, came together to give something back to the Vorderer Westen: to offer this beautiful part of Kassel a culinary alternative, and to schnucken with you.
“Schnucken” means to nibble and to savour in the North Hessian dialect, and that is exactly what we want to experience with you in our bistro. Fill the tables, share with one another, get talking, and spend a lovely evening with us. For us, a good evening means: exciting, colourful, and full of new impressions. That is exactly what we bring to the plates and into the glasses. Moments of pleasure, paired with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere and lovely people: with you.
We want to share our joy of schnucken with you: exciting natural wines, drinks, and an ever-changing menu.
Come by and let us come together, share new moments, grow with one another, and savour … let us schnucken together!
Your Schnucken team
